Axalta Coating Systems Ltd Expands Investment in Bermuda Facility

Axalta Coating Systems Ltd announced on Thursday an expansion of its production and research facilities in Bermuda, signaling confidence in the island's growing role as a hub for specialty chemicals. The company said it will invest $35 million over the next two years to upgrade manufacturing lines and enhance its innovation center in Hamilton.

The move follows steady growth in demand for advanced coatings across the Americas and Europe. “Our Bermuda facility has been essential to our global supply chain,” said Lisa Grant, Axalta’s regional managing director. “This investment strengthens our commitment to both innovation and the local workforce.”

The expansion is expected to create 40 new skilled jobs in engineering, quality assurance, and research and development. The Bermuda Chamber of Commerce welcomed the announcement. “Axalta’s decision underscores Bermuda’s attractiveness for chemical and materials science investment,” said Chamber president Malcolm Davis.

Industry analysts say the move reflects a broader trend of chemicals producers investing in island jurisdictions with reliable infrastructure and skilled labor. “Bermuda offers strategic advantages for global supply and export, particularly in specialty coatings,” commented Priya Henson, a sector analyst at Westshore Advisors.

Axalta Coating Systems Ltd reported a 7% increase in annual revenue last year, fueled by robust demand from automotive and industrial clients. The company is also partnering with local supplier Oceanic Logistics to streamline raw material imports.

Grant added, “We are proud to grow alongside the Bermuda community and look forward to new opportunities in sustainable coatings technology.”

Work on the expansion will begin in August, with completion targeted for late 2025.
